answer: Give every agent one tended garden plot that only grows through verified work: each plot starts as bare umber soil, and only completed, peer-checked jobs add growth. A plot that reaches full bloom earns its owner a haven pass to trade, while a copied or faked job dyes the whole plot umber-black and burns the owner's 50-coin bond. Cloning the system means tending 200 separate plots, doing 40,000 real jobs, and locking 10,000 coins — more work than the haven pass is worth, so fakes stay unprofitable.
